<USER_REQUEST>

Build an Android app for nurses at a small clinic to track antenatal care
(ANC) visits.

1. **Register screen:** a list of currently pregnant patients showing name,
   age, estimated due date, and current weeks of pregnancy, sorted by due
   date (soonest first).
2. Tapping a patient opens a **patient detail screen** showing her past ANC
   visits: date, weight, blood pressure, and hemoglobin if recorded.
3. From the detail screen the nurse can **record a new ANC visit** by
   filling a form with: visit date, gestational age in weeks, weight (kg),
   systolic and diastolic blood pressure (mmHg), any danger signs (none /
   vaginal bleeding / severe headache / blurred vision / fever, multiple
   allowed), and free-text notes.
4. Saving the form persists the visit; it appears in the patient's visit
   list and survives app restart.

The clinic already has these three patients on file, each with one prior
visit:

| Name | Date of birth | Est. due date | Last visit | Weight | BP | Hb |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Emily Carter | 1996-04-12 | 2026-12-05 | 2026-08-10 | 68.5 kg | 118/76 | 11.8 g/dL |
| Sarah Mitchell | 1990-11-02 | 2027-01-20 | 2026-08-12 | 61.2 kg | 110/70 | 12.4 g/dL |
| Grace Thompson | 2001-07-30 | 2026-10-15 | 2026-08-05 | 72.0 kg | 128/84 | 10.2 g/dL |

Use whatever architecture, libraries, data model, and storage you think are
best. The three existing patients above should be present in the app as
starting data.

Before you consider the task finished, make the app actually build and run.
Compile it with `./gradlew assembleDebug` and fix every error until the build
succeeds. Then, if an Android emulator is connected (check `adb devices`),
install and launch the app, confirm it opens to its main screen without
crashing, and check `adb logcat` for runtime errors. Do not report the task
as done until the app compiles and runs.

import androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

private val LightColorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = TealPrimary,
    onPrimary = TealOnPrimary,
    primaryContainer = TealPrimaryContainer,
    onPrimaryContainer = TealOnPrimaryContainer,
    secondary = SecondaryTeal,
    onSecondary = OnSecondaryTeal,
    secondaryContainer = SecondaryContainer,
    onSecondaryContainer = OnSecondaryContainer,
    error = DangerRed,
    errorContainer = DangerRedContainer,
    onError = OnDangerRed,
    onErrorContainer = OnDangerRedContainer,
    surface = SurfaceBackground
)

private val DarkColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    primary = TealPrimaryContainer,
    onPrimary = TealOnPrimaryContainer,
    secondary = SecondaryContainer,
    onSecondary = OnSecondaryContainer,
    error = DangerRedContainer,
    onError = OnDangerRedContainer
)

@Composable
fun AncTheme(
    darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val colorScheme = if (darkTheme) DarkColorScheme else LightColorScheme
    MaterialTheme(
        colorScheme = colorScheme,
        content = content
    )
}

package com.example.ancapp

import com.example.ancapp.data.AncRepository
import com.example.ancapp.model.AncVisit
import com.example.ancapp.model.DangerSigns
import com.example.ancapp.model.Patient
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.time.LocalDate

class AncModelTest {

    private val fixedToday = LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 21)

    @Test
    fun testPatientAgeCalculation() {
        val emily = Patient("p1", "Emily Carter", "1996-04-12", "2026-12-05")
        val sarah = Patient("p2", "Sarah Mitchell", "1990-11-02", "2027-01-20")
        val grace = Patient("p3", "Grace Thompson", "2001-07-30", "2026-10-15")

        assertEquals(30, emily.getAge(fixedToday))
        assertEquals(35, sarah.getAge(fixedToday))
        assertEquals(25, grace.getAge(fixedToday))
    }

    @Test
    fun testGestationalAgeCalculation() {
        // Grace Thompson: EDD 2026-10-15
        // LMP = 2026-10-15 - 280 days = 2026-01-08
        // Days to 2026-09-21 = 256 days -> 36 weeks and 4 days
        val grace = Patient("p3", "Grace Thompson", "2001-07-30", "2026-10-15")
        assertEquals(36, grace.getGestationalWeeks(fixedToday))
        assertEquals("36 wks 4 d", grace.getGestationalAgeDisplay(fixedToday))

        // Emily Carter: EDD 2026-12-05
        // LMP = 2026-12-05 - 280 days = 2026-02-28
        // Days to 2026-09-21 = 205 days -> 29 weeks and 2 days
        val emily = Patient("p1", "Emily Carter", "1996-04-12", "2026-12-05")
        assertEquals(29, emily.getGestationalWeeks(fixedToday))
        assertEquals("29 wks 2 d", emily.getGestationalAgeDisplay(fixedToday))

        // Sarah Mitchell: EDD 2027-01-20
        // LMP = 2027-01-20 - 280 days = 2026-04-15
        // Days to 2026-09-21 = 159 days -> 22 weeks and 5 days
        val sarah = Patient("p2", "Sarah Mitchell", "1990-11-02", "2027-01-20")
        assertEquals(22, sarah.getGestationalWeeks(fixedToday))
        assertEquals("22 wks 5 d", sarah.getGestationalAgeDisplay(fixedToday))
    }

    @Test
    fun testPatientSortingByDueDateSoonestFirst() {
        val patients = AncRepository.createSeedPatients()
        val sorted = patients.sortedBy { LocalDate.parse(it.estimatedDueDate) }

        assertEquals("Grace Thompson", sorted[0].name)
        assertEquals("2026-10-15", sorted[0].estimatedDueDate)

        assertEquals("Emily Carter", sorted[1].name)
        assertEquals("2026-12-05", sorted[1].estimatedDueDate)

        assertEquals("Sarah Mitchell", sorted[2].name)
        assertEquals("2027-01-20", sorted[2].estimatedDueDate)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAncVisitJsonSerialization() {
        val visit = AncVisit(
            id = "v-test-1",
            patientId = "p-1",
            date = "2026-09-21",
            gestationalAgeWeeks = 36,
            weightKg = 72.5,
            systolicBp = 120,
            diastolicBp = 80,
            hemoglobin = 11.5,
            dangerSigns = listOf(DangerSigns.FEVER, DangerSigns.SEVERE_HEADACHE),
            notes = "Complains of mild headache, vitals stable."
        )

        val json = visit.toJson()
        val restored = AncVisit.fromJson(json)

        assertEquals(visit.id, restored.id)
        assertEquals(visit.patientId, restored.patientId)
        assertEquals(visit.date, restored.date)
        assertEquals(visit.gestationalAgeWeeks, restored.gestationalAgeWeeks)
        assertEquals(visit.weightKg, restored.weightKg, 0.001)
        assertEquals(visit.systolicBp, restored.systolicBp)
        assertEquals(visit.diastolicBp, restored.diastolicBp)
        assertEquals(visit.hemoglobin, restored.hemoglobin)
        assertEquals(listOf(DangerSigns.FEVER, DangerSigns.SEVERE_HEADACHE), restored.dangerSigns)
        assertEquals(visit.notes, restored.notes)
        assertTrue(restored.hasCriticalDangerSigns)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAncVisitWithoutHemoglobin() {
        val visit = AncVisit(
            id = "v-test-2",
            patientId = "p-1",
            date = "2026-09-21",
            gestationalAgeWeeks = 30,
            weightKg = 65.0,
            systolicBp = 110,
            diastolicBp = 70,
            hemoglobin = null,
            dangerSigns = listOf(DangerSigns.NONE),
            notes = "All good."
        )

        val json = visit.toJson()
        val restored = AncVisit.fromJson(json)

        assertEquals(null, restored.hemoglobin)
        assertFalse(restored.hasCriticalDangerSigns)
        assertEquals(listOf(DangerSigns.NONE), restored.dangerSigns)
    }

    @Test
    fun testSeedDataHasThreePatientsAndVisits() {
        val seedPatients = AncRepository.createSeedPatients()
        val seedVisits = AncRepository.createSeedVisits()

        assertEquals(3, seedPatients.size)
        assertEquals(3, seedVisits.size)

        val emily = seedPatients.find { it.name == "Emily Carter" }
        assertNotNull(emily)
        val emilyVisit = seedVisits.find { it.patientId == emily!!.id }
        assertNotNull(emilyVisit)
        assertEquals("2026-08-10", emilyVisit!!.date)
        assertEquals(68.5, emilyVisit.weightKg, 0.001)
        assertEquals(118, emilyVisit.systolicBp)
        assertEquals(76, emilyVisit.diastolicBp)
        assertEquals(11.8, emilyVisit.hemoglobin!!, 0.001)

        val sarah = seedPatients.find { it.name == "Sarah Mitchell" }
        assertNotNull(sarah)
        val sarahVisit = seedVisits.find { it.patientId == sarah!!.id }
        assertNotNull(sarahVisit)
        assertEquals("2026-08-12", sarahVisit!!.date)
        assertEquals(61.2, sarahVisit.weightKg, 0.001)
        assertEquals(110, sarahVisit.systolicBp)
        assertEquals(70, sarahVisit.diastolicBp)
        assertEquals(12.4, sarahVisit.hemoglobin!!, 0.001)

        val grace = seedPatients.find { it.name == "Grace Thompson" }
        assertNotNull(grace)
        val graceVisit = seedVisits.find { it.patientId == grace!!.id }
        assertNotNull(graceVisit)
        assertEquals("2026-08-05", graceVisit!!.date)
        assertEquals(72.0, graceVisit.weightKg, 0.001)
        assertEquals(128, graceVisit.systolicBp)
        assertEquals(84, graceVisit.diastolicBp)
        assertEquals(10.2, graceVisit.hemoglobin!!, 0.001)
    }
}
